Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped in the right lane of the roadway in Sugar Land, Texas, waiting for slow-moving traffic ahead
when the rear of the vehicle was struck by a pickup operated by Driver 2. Driver 1's vehicle was pushed forward into
the stopped car in front, and the impact was consistent with the damage visible to both rear and front bumper areas.
A Passenger was seated in the front seat of Driver 1's vehicle and was also present at the scene, and both the
Passenger and Driver 2 confirmed that Driver 1 was inside the vehicle at the time of impact. Driver 2 stated that the
collision occurred just as Driver 1 described it, and two independent witnesses who were in nearby vehicles gave
matching accounts. Photographs taken at the scene show no prior damage to either vehicle's rear panel, and no
earlier collision history was noted. Driver 1 reported neck and back pain and was transported for evaluation, and the
reported symptoms fit the speed and force of the impact. Driver 1 was listed as a named insured on the policy
covering the vehicle.
